items.message: The `--registered` assertion is coupled to a specific module path string and will silently pass if the set of registered workflows changes.
The isolation assertion for `show-workflow implement/report` depends on the set of sibling function names remaining stable; a rename would silently weaken it.

`_workflow_ids` uses a regex over `inspect.getsource(module.register)` to discover workflow ids; `test_the_id_discovery_is_not_vacuous` asserts the exact expected set, which is the right test, but no test covers what happens when `register()` source is unavailable (e.g. a `.pyc`-only install).
No test covers `show-workflow <family>` when the family has no discoverable ids (i.e. the regex returns an empty set for a reformatted `register()`).
